::: {#hero-heading}
I will be joining **[BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus](https://www.bits-pilani.ac.in/hyderabad/)** as an **Assistant Professor** in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, starting **Jan 29, 2026**.

Prior to this, I was a Postdoctoral Researcher in the Department of Mathematics at [ULisboa](https://www.ulisboa.pt/), working under the supervision of [Bruno Loff](https://brunoloff.wordpress.com/) on the Hardness of Finding Good Algorithms ([HoFGA](https://brunoloff.wordpress.com/hofga/)) project. I was also a member of [LASIGE](https://lasige.pt/), a research unit at the Faculty of Sciences, University of Lisbon ([FCUL](https://ciencias.ulisboa.pt/)).

I obtained my PhD from Tata Institute of Fundamental Research ([TIFR](https://www.tifr.res.in/)), Mumbai, under the guidance of [Prahladh Harsha](https://www.tcs.tifr.res.in/~prahladh/).

## Research Interests

Circuit Complexity, Communication and Query Complexity, Analysis of Boolean functions, Data Structures.

## Education

PhD in Computer Science \| 2023 </br> Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Mumbai.

MSc in Computer Science \| 2014 </br> Chennai Mathematical Institute, Chennai.

BSc(Hons.) in Mathematics and Computer Science \| 2012 </br> Chennai Mathematical Institute, Chennai.
:::
